title: EVALUESTEER: MEASURING REWARD MODEL STEERABILITY TOWARDS VALUES AND PREFERENCES
reasoning: The paper introduces EVALUESTEER, a benchmark that evaluates how well reward models can be steered toward specific human values and moral beliefs. It utilizes the World Values Survey (WVS) to categorize user profiles along dimensions like 'traditional vs. secular-rational,' which includes assessing model responses to topics such as the importance of God, abortion, and moral/cultural norms.
